title: Entity item effect condition
description: Tests if the given entity passes the given condition(s).

condition.$comment: An entity predicate used to test for different properties of the entity.

canFreeze.$comment: If provided, whether or not the entity can freeze (entity can accumulate freezing ticks) needs to match this value.

isFreezing.$comment: If provided, whether or not the entity is freezing (freezing ticks is > 0) needs to match this value.

isFrozen.$comment: If provided, whether or not the entity is frozen (freezing ticks is above freezing limit) needs to match this value.

isRiding.$comment: If provided, whether or not the entity is riding on another entity needs to match this value.

origin.$comment: Used as a reference point for the optional 'distance' field in the condition, can be omitted if that's not used.
